integrity.policy: UTF-8 text hashes normalize CRLF/lone CR to LF; other assets are exact raw bytes. Native object identities retain exact Git provenance. Derivation inputs and generators are separate from storage history.
integrity.migrationPrograms: Checked asset manifest plus browser startup program/control-JSON verification. Erased-workflow interception must fail before ready.
integrity.routingLock: Generated reviewed intent lock, not independent correctness proof; source-context expectations and review are checked separately.
integrity.nativeSourceAudit: Independent Git-tree/Python-AST counts and source digest verification; historical test routes are capability evidence, not execution of all Python assertions.

limitations: Bounded offline workflows do not reproduce the full geographic publications or establish native GPU visual parity.
W09 historical captures retain kernel hashes and parameters; the original authoring harness is not archived.
Chromium preflight only. Physical browser/GPU and final functional/visual release qualification remain W24 work.

ciFollowup.scope: CI reproduction, scratch initialization, unchanged raw-byte oracle checks, and adapter-independent OIT contribution suppression.

ciReproductions.result: Application fixture raw-byte check failed; not reproduced locally with the same Python/NumPy versions, alternate hash seeds or reduced CPU features. Original raw equality assertion retained; candidate bytes and first JSON differences now saved on failure.

Early oracle run exposed missing test-results scratch directory on fresh checkout. build_cases now creates it before TemporaryDirectory. Fresh-root integration probe reproduced all 24 example / 29 operation outputs byte-for-byte.

Both early and original late raw-byte oracle checks passed. Installed W23 reached the OIT negative control, which failed because no-op setOit leaves auto mode and auto selects WBOIT without dual-source blending. The control now forces standard blending and retains the same Weighted OIT rejection assertion.
